newsitem.title: JAPAN: Thai FinMin says hopes rates will reach 10 pct. [CORRECTED 09:51 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Thai FinMin says hopes rates will reach 10 pct. [CORRECTED 09:51 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to show that Thai Finance Minister said he hopes to see Thai interest rates at 10 percent, not the dollar/baht rate at 10 baht per dollar.)
Thailand's Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Friday he would like to see Thai interest rates brought down to about 10 percent.

Referring to interest rates, he said: "I would like to see it, again it is related to the U.S. dollar's rate and the international market rates of other currencies but in the history of Thailand if the baht (interest) rate can be brought down to about 10 (percent) that would be very sufficient for the businessmen who will be very pleased because the inflation rate at about five to six percent that means the effective rate of interest is about four to five percent only. I think that would be efficient for the market mechanism."
